versions.changelog:
- Initial release of ppt-visual-designer skill for turning complex business logic and organizational structures into Block-style visual PPT slides.
- Strict color and typography system based on tone-on-tone logic for clarity and distinction.
- Provides three output options: structured slide outline, HTML presentation code, or Python-pptx code.
- Includes modular design patterns: keyword card grids, flywheel diagrams, and before/after contrast layouts.
- Detailed process for dimensionality reduction, flywheel detection, and comparative block design.
